official_origin.limits: 46cm is approximate; if sensor bottom is tilted the tape measurement must refer to the bottom-center under O. Actual physical tilt is not independently surveyed.

T3_description: Driver high-resolution Cartesian branch computes p_out=R_driver*p_raw+t_driver (mm converted to m). T3=E for baseline; diagnostic C@E for candidate.
T2_description: lookupTransform(target=odom_child_frame_id=base_link, source=rslidar) gives A. LidarCallback first applies A, then F built from IMU RPY with yaw=0 and tz=.34751; T2=F@A.
T1_description: P is the full published_pose used to transform the filtered cloud, also published as /patrol/registration_odom. It can differ from raw /patrol/ndt_candidate Q. /odom and /tf zero Z and are not substituted for P.
equation: T_map_raw_lidar = T1 @ T2 @ T3 = P @ F @ A @ E (baseline)
